initContainers:
  - name: dind
    image: docker:29-dind
    securityContext:
      privileged: true
    restartPolicy: Always
    env:
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_CERTDIR
        value: /certs
      - name: CURL_CA_BUNDLE
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      - name: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      - name: REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
      - name: SSL_CERT_FILE
        value: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-storage
        mountPath: /var/lib/docker
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
      - name: homelab-root-ca
        mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
        subPath: ca.crt
        readOnly: true
    startupProbe:
      exec:
        command:
          - sh
          - -c
          - >-
            docker --tlsverify --tlscacert=/certs/client/ca.pem --tlscert=/certs/client/cert.pem
            --tlskey=/certs/client/key.pem -H tcp://localhost:2376 info
      initialDelaySeconds: 5
      periodSeconds: 1
      failureThreshold: 30
containers:
  - env:
      - name: DEBIAN_FRONTEND
        value: noninteractive
      - name: DOCKER_HOST
        value: tcp://localhost:2376
      - name: DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY
        value: "1"
      - name: DOCKER_CERT_PATH
        value: /certs/client
    image: ghcr.io/bjw-s-labs/forgejo-runner:ubuntu-24.04@sha256:b16190bb905d533ccc21b6762198ebc52366c3df23b3ab538270f8953c5973bc
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 8Gi
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: docker-certs
        mountPath: /certs
        readOnly: true
      - name: homelab-root-ca
        mountPath: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
        subPath: ca.crt
        readOnly: true
volumes:
  - name: docker-storage
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: docker-certs
    emptyDir: {}
  - name: homelab-root-ca
    configMap:
      name: homelab-root-ca
      defaultMode: 420
restartPolicy: Never
serviceAccount: forgejo-runner
serviceAccountName: forgejo-runner

initContainers:
  - name: 01-nix-store
    image: nixos/nix:2.35.2@sha256:7a007c766426c1877758ddc5cb87a965ac131fc78c582ce0083d922d51ae945c
    command:
      - sh
      - -c
      - |
        if [ ! -d /data/store ]; then
          cp -a /nix/. /data/
        else
          # /etc in the image symlinks into /nix/store, so seed paths missing after image bumps
          cp -an /nix/store/. /data/store/
        fi
    resources:
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 256Mi
      limits:
        memory: 1Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: runner-nix-data
        mountPath: /data
containers:
  - image: nixos/nix:2.35.2@sha256:7a007c766426c1877758ddc5cb87a965ac131fc78c582ce0083d922d51ae945c
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
    name: main
    env:
      - name: NIX_CONFIG
        value: |-
          max-jobs = 2
          cores = 4
    resources:
      limits:
        memory: 24Gi
      requests:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 8Gi
    volumeMounts:
      - name: runner-nix-data
        mountPath: /nix
volumes:
  - name: runner-nix-data
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: runner-nix-data
restartPolicy: Never
serviceAccount: forgejo-runner
serviceAccountName: forgejo-runner

[Lidarr]
api_key = $${LIDARR_API_KEY}
host_url = http://lidarr.media.svc.cluster.local
download_dir = /media/Downloads/soulseek/complete
disable_sync = False

[Slskd]
api_key = $${SLSKD_API_KEY}
host_url = http://slskd.downloads.svc.cluster.local
url_base = /
download_dir = /media/Downloads/soulseek/complete
delete_searches = False
stalled_timeout = 3600
remote_queue_timeout = 300

[Release Settings]
use_selected_lidarr_release = False
use_most_common_tracknum = True
allow_multi_disc = True
accepted_countries = Europe,Japan,United Kingdom,United States,[Worldwide],Australia,Canada,Portugal
skip_region_check = False
accepted_formats = CD,Digital Media,Vinyl

[Search Settings]
search_timeout = 5000
maximum_peer_queue = 50
minimum_peer_upload_speed = 0
minimum_filename_match_ratio = 0.8
minimum_search_interval = 5
allowed_filetypes = flac,mp3 320,mp3
ignored_users =
album_prepend_artist = False
search_type = incrementing_page
number_of_albums_to_grab = 10
title_blacklist =
search_blacklist =
search_source = missing
failed_import_denylist = True

[Download Settings]
download_filtering = True
use_extension_whitelist = False
extensions_whitelist = lrc,nfo,txt

[Logging]
level = INFO
format = [%(levelname)s|%(module)s|L%(lineno)d] %(asctime)s: %(message)s
datefmt = %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z
log_to_file = True
log_file = soularr.log
max_bytes = 1048576
backup_count = 3
